") center/cover no-repeat !important;box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(30,116,176,.24), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.34) !important;}
.home-shell::before,.home-shell::after,.home-hero-art,.home-logo-wrap{display:none !important;content:none !important;}
.home-settings-fab{position:absolute !important;right:8px !important;top:8px !important;width:72px !important;height:72px !important;z-index:20 !important;opacity:0 !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;color:transparent !important;}
.play-main{position:absolute !important;left:13.5% !important;right:13.5% !important;top:60.8% !important;height:14.2% !important;margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;z-index:15 !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;color:transparent !important;font-size:0 !important;display:block !important;}
.play-main *{display:none !important;}
.home-actions{position:absolute !important;left:9.8% !important;right:9.8% !important;top:80.3% !important;height:11.6% !important;margin:0 !important;display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) !important;gap:3.2% !important;z-index:15 !important;}
.icon-action{width:100% !important;height:100% !important;margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;color:transparent !important;display:block !important;}
.icon-action *{display:none !important;}
#resetProgress{background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;}
.score-banner{position:absolute !important;left:14.2% !important;right:14.2% !important;bottom:2.8% !important;height:10.2% !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;z-index:16 !important;pointer-events:none !important;overflow:visible !important;display:block !important;padding:0 !important;}
.score-banner::before{content:'' !important;position:absolute !important;left:41% !important;top:36% !important;width:44% !important;height:40% !important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2ab7ff 0%, #1da4ef 100%) !important;border-radius:18px !important;z-index:0 !important;}
.score-banner > :not(#bestEndless){display:none !important;}
.score-banner #bestEndless{position:absolute !important;left:41% !important;top:27% !important;width:44% !important;height:auto !important;display:block !important;text-align:center !important;color:#ffe24c !important;font-size:clamp(30px,7.5vw,48px) !important;font-weight:1000 !important;letter-spacing:.06em !important;line-height:1 !important;text-shadow:0 4px 0 #0b6fbe,0 0 10px rgba(255,241,133,.38) !important;transform:none !important;z-index:1 !important;}
@media(max-width:430px){
  .home-shell{width:min(96vw,420px) !important;height:min(84vh,760px) !important;}
  .home-settings-fab{width:64px !important;height:64px !important;right:7px !important;top:7px !important;}
  .play-main{top:60.8% !important;height:14.2% !important;}
  .home-actions{top:80.4% !important;height:11.5% !important;gap:3.2% !important;}
  .score-banner{bottom:2.6% !important;height:10.2% !important;}
  .score-banner #bestEndless{font-size:clamp(26px,8vw,42px) !important;}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <canvas id="game" width="540" height="960"></canvas>

  <div id="home" class="overlay active home-screen">
    <div class="page-ribbon">PAGE D'ACCUEIL</div>
    <div class="home-shell">
      <div class="home-hero-art" id="heroPreview"></div>
      <button class="home-settings-fab" id="openOptions" aria-label="Options">⚙️</button>
      <div class="home-logo-wrap">
        <h1 class="home-logo"><span class="top">Nuage</span><span class="bottom">Nomade</span></h1>
      </div>
      <button class="play-main" id="playAdventure"><span class="play-triangle">▶</span><span>JOUER</span></button>
      <div class="home-actions">
        <button class="icon-action" id="goLevels"><span class="icon">🗺️</span><span class="txt">Niveaux</span></button>
        <button class="icon-action" id="playEndless"><span class="icon">🏆</span><span class="txt">Infini</span></button>
        <button class="icon-action" id="resetProgress"><span class="icon">▶️</span><span class="txt">Continuer</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="score-banner">👑 <span class="label">MEILLEUR SCORE</span><span id="bestEndless">000000</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>


  <div id="optionsScreen" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="option-title">Options</div>
      <div class="subtitle" style="color:#1d4f7a;text-shadow:none">Choisis la difficulté pour tes essais.</div>
      <div class="difficulty-pick">
        <button class="difficulty-btn" id="modeNormal"><div>Normal</div><small>1 choc = Game Over</small></button>
        <button class="difficulty-btn" id="modeEasy"><div>Facile</div><small>2 chocs avant Game Over</small></button>
      </div>
      <div class="difficulty-desc" id="difficultyInfo">Mode normal : un choc termine la partie.</div>
      <button class="btn white" id="closeOptions">RETOUR</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="levelSelect" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="map-header">
        <h2>Carte des niveaux</h2>
        <button class="small-btn" id="backHomeFromMap">Accueil</button>
      </div>
      <div class="subtitle" style="color:#1d4f7a;text-shadow:none;margin-top:-6px">Rejoue les niveaux terminés ou poursuis ton aventure</div>
      <div class="level-grid" id="levelGrid"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="hud" class="hud">
    <div class="hud-top">
      <button class="hud-btn" id="backMap">←</button>
      <div class="hud-center">
        <div class="hud-minirow">
          <span id="levelName" class="level-inline">Niveau</span>
          <span class="score-chip" id="scoreText">000000</span>
        </div>
        <div class="bar top-progress"><span id="progressFill"></span></div>
        <div class="hud-meta">
          <span class="meta-inline">⭐ <b id="starCount">0</b>/<span id="starGoal">0</span></span>
          <span class="meta-inline feather-meter"><span class="feather-glyph">🪶</span><b id="featherCount">0</b>/4</span>
          <span class="meta-inline life-hud" id="lifeHud">❤️❤️</span>
          <span class="meta-inline bonus-active-hud" id="bonusHud"><img id="bonusHudIcon" alt=""><b id="bonusHudTimer"></b></span>
          <span id="progressLabel" class="progress-inline">0%</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="hud-btn" id="pauseBtn">Ⅱ</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="pauseScreen" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel">
      <h2>Pause</h2>
      <div class="subtitle" style="color:#1d4f7a;text-shadow:none">Prends ton souffle, puis repars à l'aventure.</div>
      <button class="btn secondary" id="resumeBtn">REPRENDRE</button>
      <button class="btn white" id="restartBtn">RECOMMENCER</button>
      <button class="btn white" id="pauseToMap">CARTE DES NIVEAUX</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="completeScreen" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="ribbon">Niveau terminé !</div>
      <div class="stars" id="resultStars"></div>
      <div class="results-grid">
        <div class="card"><small>Score</small><strong id="finalScore">000000</strong></div>
        <div class="card"><small>Record niveau</small><strong id="finalBest">000000</strong></div>
        <div class="card"><small>Étoiles ramassées</small><strong id="finalCollect">0/0</strong></div>
        <div class="card"><small>Ennemi frôlé</small><strong id="finalNear">0</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tiny-row">
        <button class="btn secondary" id="nextLevelBtn">NIVEAU SUIVANT</button>
        <button class="btn orange" id="replayBtn">REJOUER</button>
      </div>
      <button class="btn white" id="completeToMap">CARTE DES NIVEAUX</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="gameOverScreen" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel dark">
      <h2 style="color:white">Game Over</h2>
      <div class="subtitle" style="margin-top:-2px">Le vent s'est montré plus fort cette fois.</div>
      <div class="results-grid">
        <div class="card"><small>Score</small><strong id="deadScore">000000</strong></div>
        <div class="card"><small>Distance</small><strong id="deadDist">0%</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tiny-row">
        <button class="btn secondary" id="retryDead">REJOUER</button>
        <button class="btn white" id="deadToMap">CARTE DES NIVEAUX</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="newLevelScreen" class="overlay">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="ribbon">Nouveau niveau débloqué !</div>
      <h2 id="unlockedName" style="margin-top:12px">Chapitre débloqué</h2>
      <div class="subtitle" id="unlockedDesc" style="color:#1d4f7a;text-shadow:none">De nouveaux paysages t'attendent.</div>
      <button class="btn secondary" id="continueUnlocked">CONTINUER</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
</div>
<script>

  const W = 540, H = 960;
  const cvs = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');

  const HD_L1_SRC = {

    player: "data:image/webp;base64,
